subject.title: Silent empty tool results in long-running Sonnet 5 sessions after a large tool result

question: Should https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99524 be treated as the canonical fix path for this issue's long-session empty tool-result reports, or should this issue require separate installed cross-provider payload proof?
rationale: The issue evidence and later cross-provider comment strongly overlap with the open prompt-projection candidate PR, but the PR is not merged and the exact failing installed-session payload has not been proven after-fix.

options.title: Refresh and review candidate PR
options.body: Treat the open prompt-projection PR or a refreshed successor as the canonical fix path, then verify this issue against that merged behavior.

options.title: Require installed payload proof
options.body: Keep this issue separate until a redacted failing and after-fix provider-bound payload comparison proves the candidate covers this report.

options.title: Split a narrower follow-up
options.body: If the candidate PR fixes only the non-trailing fresh-result case, keep a follow-up for any remaining queue, compaction, or provider-specific trigger.

recommendation.title: Refresh and review candidate PR
recommendation.body: Treat the open prompt-projection PR or a refreshed successor as the canonical fix path, then verify this issue against that merged behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the adjacent merged fresh-result protection and are the strongest history signal for this prompt-projection tradeoff.
